_doc: Canonical Point shape (structural only). Used by input.mouse.click/move/scroll's actual_position output and input.position's {x, y} output. Per-verb description text varies (the actual position has a slightly different semantic in each verb — clamped landing point vs cursor target vs synthesised wheel position vs current cursor position). Validator (tests/check_spec.py) checks structure only: type, required, additionalProperties, and the property keys. Description text is a per-verb override.
